title: Product hero 3D (Three.js)
description: A premium studio product hero built in code: a stylised stand-in product (bottle, can, jar, box or phone-like slab, generic shapes with the name printed on its label) sits on a seamless floor with a soft contact shadow and a fading reflection. Rim lights draw the silhouette, then the key light sweeps on; the camera orbits, pushes in or pulls back from a macro detail; the name rises word by word, the tagline follows and a call-to-action pill pops in, with an 'Illustrative 3D render' footnote. Any aspect ratio. Not a model of any real product.

form.description: Stand-in product shape: bottle (glass or plastic with cap and label), can (aluminium with printed wrap), jar (wide, lidded), box (printed package), phone (thin slab with screen and camera bump)

name.description: Product name: the headline, also printed on the label

tagline.description: One line under the name (empty for none)

cta.description: Call to action in the pill button (empty for none)

footnote.description: Small line under the call to action; keep a disclosure that the product is a rendered stand-in

palette.description: Ground (studio backdrop and floor), ink (copy; replaced by a 4.5:1 colour if too low in contrast) and accent (cap or lid, rules, button)

body_color.description: Product body colour, used when colorway is 'preset'

finish.description: Body surface; glass applies to bottle and jar (with tinted contents) and reads as gloss on other forms

label.description: Print the name on the product's label or front face

move.description: Camera move over the first 55% of the shot: orbit (70-degree arc), push (wide to hero push-in), reveal (macro detail pulling back to the hero frame); then a slow drift

lighting.description: Light rig: studio (key, fill and two rims), soft (bright and even), dramatic (low environment, hard rims)

spin.description: Turns the product makes during the shot (it always ends facing the camera)

reflection.description: Floor reflection strength near the product (0 for none)

glow.description: Bloom on highlights (0 turns the post-processing pass off). Very costly on software WebGL: about 25 s of render per output second at 1080x1920, so no preset uses it

msaa.description: Multisample anti-aliasing on product edges (off renders somewhat faster for drafts)

noir.name: Lumen One
noir.tagline: All-day battery in a 7 mm frame

cream.name: Oat & Honey
cream.tagline: Rich night cream for dry skin

forest.name: Field Kit
forest.tagline: Everything for a first night outdoors

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`; renders on software WebGL (SwiftShader).
The product is a generic stand-in built from lathe, box and extrude primitives; it is not a likeness of any real product, and the default footnote says so on screen.
Beats (D = duration): key light sweeps on 0.06D-0.32D, camera move ends 0.55D, name 0.42D, tagline 0.50D, call to action 0.62D, footnote 0.50D + 0.2 s.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
Measured on software WebGL (SwiftShader) at 1080x1920, 30 fps, including setup: about 5.0-5.4 s of render per output second without glow.
